facts.fact: NITA-U's UGhub integration platform is live, enabling data sharing across Uganda government systems and the private sector, per DIAL.
DIAL states 113 public and private entities have been boarded on UGhub.
DIAL reports over 90 million transactions conducted through UGhub, as reported by NITA-U.

UGA.note: No public digital-skills programme or measured share stated.
Only names a Digital Transformation Roadmap in passing; no standing, text or plan stated.
No online government services portal or count stated.
Grievance mechanisms are for UGhub participants, not public-service feedback.
Only an Africa-wide internet user growth figure; none for Uganda.
Says UGhub is built by Ugandans, but names no government staff running it or a state body building systems.
